theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : Set (Euclid n)) (v : Euclid n → ℝ) (d : ℝ), Convex ℝ Q → MeasurableSet Q → 0 ≤ d → (∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ Q, ‖x - y‖ ≤ d) → ContDiff ℝ 1 v → ∫ x in Q, ∫ y in Q, |v x - v y| ≤ 2 ^ n * d * (volume Q).toReal * ∫ z in Q, ‖fderiv ℝ v z‖
